newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan overnight rates stay at 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan overnight rates stay at 20 pct.

text.p: Pakistani interbank overnight rates stayed at 20 percent on Tuesday amid a shortage of funds in the banking system, dealers said.

"Bids and offers stayed pegged with the State (central) Bank of Pakistan's discount rate of 20 percent," a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank in Karachi said. A significant amount was said to have been discounted at the central bank's counters.
"The market is expected to trade at these levels till there are significant inflows into the banking system," the dealer said.
